subject: Correct RDB_EOF_MARK_SIZE usage where EOF mark is relevant (#925)
reason: The change replaces CONFIG_RUN_ID_SIZE with RDB_EOF_MARK_SIZE in readSyncBulkPayload's diskless-sync EOF-mark handling. Both macros are defined as 40 (src/server.h:128-129), so every buffer declaration, memcpy, memmove, memcmp and ftruncate offset in the changed code compiles to the identical constant as before. It is a pure readability/semantic refactor with no behavior change on any path — replication, resync and RDB transfer behave byte-for-byte the same — so there is nothing a scenario could distinguish between the two builds.
